fixer.summary: Moved the grappled_by test helper into tests/support/helpers.py, using the variadic signature `grappled_by(target, *grapplers)`. It replaces the two-argument versions without changing any call. I deleted the three local copies in test_effects.py, test_combat.py and test_api.py, and they now import it from tests.support.helpers. test_api.py's `Condition` import was no longer used, so I dropped it. All 335 unit tests pass, ruff check and ruff format --check are clean, and dev-gate passes. This ticket names no acceptance tests and no engine code changed, so I added no SRD tags.
